name: Nakagawa Kuniko
source:
She followed in the footsteps of her mother who recently retired. She specializes in urology.

At first glance she looks cold. She takes pride in being a doctor and is very gentle when examining patients. She has a personality that views everything as black and white.

She is divorced but the causes for it are unknown. She has no children and treats them as if they were her own. She's particularly fond of the protagonist and genuinely treats him as her own son.

She always wears a white coat and has very big tits.
 
[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complets/MM3/index.html]official site[/url]]
